meta.title: xopc — Private AI Workspace for Long-running Work
meta.description: Start with chat, run your agent on your computer, capture notes from your phone, and turn repeated follow-up into a private AI workspace.
meta.ogDescription: XOPC grows from local chat into project context, mobile note capture, connectors, and automations while your agent and data stay in your own runtime.

hero.titleEm: Keep direction, action, and feedback aligned.
hero.desc: Start with a local chat. Keep projects alive. Pair the mobile app by QR code to capture notes and ideas anywhere. Automations turn repeated follow-up into a private data flywheel.

download.hackableComment: # Source install — for contributors and deep customization
download.hackablePnpmInstallCommand: cd xopc && corepack enable && pnpm install
download.hackablePnpmComment2: # Run from source; build then onboard
download.hackablePnpmOnboardCommand: pnpm run build && pnpm exec xopc onboard
download.title: Up and running in 30 seconds.
download.subtitle: One command installs Node.js and xopc, then walks you through onboarding — macOS, Linux, or Windows.
download.quickInstallComment: # One command — macOS, Linux, and Windows.
download.quickInstallFootnote: Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows. The one-liner installs Node.js and everything else for you. Hackable clones from git for local hacking. Switch tabs for npm or desktop downloads.
download.advancedSubtitle: If you already have Node.js 22+ and prefer the package manager route.
download.npmBody: Node.js 22+ required. pnpm is also supported: pnpm add -g @xopcai/xopc. China mirror: npm install -g @xopcai/xopc --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com. Then chat: xopc tui --local
download.npmOnboardBody: Interactive onboarding — pick your model and add API keys. Faster path: xopc onboard --quick

demo.titleLine2: It is loops that keep moving.
demo.desc: From install and setup to every surface: one private agent stays continuous across terminal, desktop, browser, mobile, and messengers.

features.desc: Models, surfaces, workflows, and extensions serve one promise: turn useful context into the next action, then bring feedback back into the loop.

items.title: Bring your own API keys. Choose any model.
items.body: DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Bedrock, Azure, and 20+ providers are built in. Run fully local inference or mix cloud and local models; switch with one config line and avoid vendor lock-in.

items.title: One assistant across every screen.
items.body: Terminal, browser, desktop app, phone, and messengers all connect to the same system. No context resync needed — every surface reaches the same assistant.

items.title: Your phone is a private remote control.
items.body: Run the agent on your computer, pair the mobile app by QR code, and capture notes, ideas, blockers, or project updates from anywhere without moving your data into a hosted chat account.

items.title: Dynamic workflows
items.body: Fan out isolated subagents from deterministic scripts: repo audits, multi-perspective reviews, and parallel research. Each run gets its own session with live progress.

items.title: Multi-agent routing
items.body: Route different contexts to different agents — each with its own model, workspace, tools, and system prompt. Fully isolated contexts for work, creativity, and code.

items.title: Extend it without hitting preset limits.
items.body: Install Skills with one command. Add Extensions for tools, channels, and UI panels. Use Cron for scheduled automation. XOPC is your system — shape it around your goals.

items.title: Your machine. Your rules.
items.body: xopc runs on your hardware. Conversations, project context, and local state stay in your xopc runtime. API keys stay in your config. No mandatory cloud. No surprise bills.

items.title: HTTP/SSE gateway
items.body: REST JSON APIs plus Server-Sent Events for streaming and live updates, with the same React console you get in Electron. Open the URL from logs or gateway config.

items.title: Type-Safe Tool System
items.body: Build custom tools with TypeBox schemas. Web search, browser control (Playwright, opt-in), file operations — extend your agent's capabilities.

items.title: Voice & vision
items.body: STT/TTS where configured — e.g. Telegram and gateway paths. Images: vision plus generation when you wire it up; see the Voice and Tools docs.

cta.desc: MIT open source. Local-first. Install, onboard, pair your phone when ready, and start building your own system for long-term progress.

belief.title: What matters should not rely on willpower alone.
belief.body: Meaningful goals often take months, years, or longer. They need to be remembered, moved forward, reflected on, and recalibrated. Sustained progress comes from loops, not motivation alone.
belief.linesLabel: Common ways meaningful goals lose momentum

loop.titleLine2: You do not need the whole system on day one.
loop.desc: Start with a normal conversation. Add project context, notes, mobile capture, connectors, and automation only when the work needs them.

steps.title: Chat
steps.body: Ask questions, think through work, and make decisions in a local assistant.

steps.title: Project
steps.body: Ask xopc to follow one goal over time: current state, blockers, decisions, and next actions.

steps.title: Notes
steps.body: Drop rough ideas, links, progress updates, and feedback whenever they happen.

steps.title: Mobile
steps.body: Pair by QR code and keep capturing context from your phone while the agent runs on your computer.

steps.title: Automations
steps.body: Schedule reviews, reminders, summaries, and workflow runs so the loop keeps moving.
